versions.changelog:
- Initial release of meta-self-play-coevolution, an enhanced meta-skill distilled from self-play-coevolution.
- Adds reliable self-verification (reason-verify) and self-reflection loops to detect and learn from failure modes.
- Integrates into super-agent workflows, supporting perception, planning, execution, verification, reflection, and memory.
- Introduces adversarial tests to ensure distilled rules are robust and not superficial.
- Enables continuous self-evolution, growing stronger with use via the meta-evolver framework.
- Outputs are more reliable and traceable compared to the original teacher skill.
